summary.text: Bryce Lockwood is the Democratic candidate for the Missouri House of Representatives, District 137, in the November 3, 2026 general election, after advancing from the August 4 Democratic primary.
He also ran for the seat in 2024.

paragraphs.text: In a 2022 Ballotpedia survey, Bryce Lockwood said he and his wife graduated from Baptist Bible College in Springfield, Missouri, in 1982, and that he was ordained that year.

He said he served as a pastor in Nixa, Missouri, and as an associate pastor in Key West, Florida, and Springfield, then worked in the feed and grain business and owned a small trucking company, retiring from Associated Wholesale Grocers in Springfield in 2003.

Lockwood said he filed to run for Missouri's 7th Congressional District on March 29, 2022, citing concerns about affordable health care, expansion of the Medicare program and the condition of transportation networks, and listed voting rights, women's rights and equal rights as key messages.
Darin Chappell defeated Lockwood in the general election for Missouri House District 137 on November 5, 2024.
